--- pipe_join_types.sql
FROM LeftTable AS l
|> INNER JOIN FirstTable AS r1 ON l.id = r1.id
|> RIGHT JOIN SecondTable AS r2 ON l.id = r2.id
|> FULL OUTER JOIN ThirdTable AS r3 ON l.id = r3.id

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 14,
            Name:    "LeftTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    15,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 18,
              NameEnd: 19,
              Name:    "l",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:  20,
        Op:    "INNER JOIN",
        Right: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 34,
            NameEnd: 44,
            Name:    "FirstTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    45,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 48,
              NameEnd: 50,
              Name:    "r1",
            },
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.On{
          On:   51,
          Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
            Op:   "=",
            Left: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 54,
                  NameEnd: 55,
                  Name:    "l",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 56,
                  NameEnd: 58,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
            Right: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 61,
                  NameEnd: 63,
                  Name:    "r1",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 64,
                  NameEnd: 66,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:  67,
        Op:    "RIGHT OUTER JOIN",
        Right: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 81,
            NameEnd: 92,
            Name:    "SecondTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    93,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 96,
              NameEnd: 98,
              Name:    "r2",
            },
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.On{
          On:   99,
          Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
            Op:   "=",
            Left: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 102,
                  NameEnd: 103,
                  Name:    "l",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 104,
                  NameEnd: 106,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
            Right: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 109,
                  NameEnd: 111,
                  Name:    "r2",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 112,
                  NameEnd: 114,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:  115,
        Op:    "FULL OUTER JOIN",
        Right: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 134,
            NameEnd: 144,
            Name:    "ThirdTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    145,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 148,
              NameEnd: 150,
              Name:    "r3",
            },
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.On{
          On:   151,
          Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
            Op:   "=",
            Left: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 154,
                  NameEnd: 155,
                  Name:    "l",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 156,
                  NameEnd: 158,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
            Right: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 161,
                  NameEnd: 163,
                  Name:    "r3",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 164,
                  NameEnd: 166,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LeftTable AS l |> INNER JOIN FirstTable AS r1 ON l.id = r1.id |> RIGHT OUTER JOIN SecondTable AS r2 ON l.id = r2.id |> FULL OUTER JOIN ThirdTable AS r3 ON l.id = r3.id
